title: A series of dysprosium clusters assembled by a substitution effect-driven out-to-in growth mechanism

synthesis.procedure: H4L1 (0.05 mmol, ca. 25 mg), Dy(NO3)3·6H2O (0.4 mmol, ca. 183 mg), CH3OH (1.5 mL), CH3CN (0.5 mL), and triethylamine (0.15 mL) were placed in a sealed Pyrex tube (one end ca. 25 cm), shaken and sonicated for 15 min, heated at 80 °C for 3 days, then slowly cooled to room temperature to give yellow lumpy crystals. Yield ca. 52.3% based on the ligand.
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Slow cooling to room temperature afforded yellow lumpy crystals.

properties.summary: Under 1000 Oe, χMT falls on cooling from 214.00 cm3 mol−1 K at room temperature, attributed to Stark sublevel depopulation and weak antiferromagnetic interactions. Magnetization at 2 K and 5 T is 90.3 Nβ, below the 160 Nβ saturation value, with non-superimposable isotherms indicating strong anisotropy; the 2 K hysteresis loop is not obvious. Zero-field AC susceptibility (1–1000 Hz, 2–15 K) is frequency dependent without a peak (fast QTM); no field effect is seen up to 2000 Oe. Debye fitting gives Ueff = 2.6 K and τ0 = 1.9×10−6 s, described as SMM-like behavior.

properties.summary: χMT is 126.73 cm3 mol−1 K at room temperature under 1000 Oe and decreases on cooling, assigned to crystal-field effects and weak antiferromagnetic coupling. Magnetization reaches 47.7 Nβ at 2 K and 5 T (theoretical 100 Nβ) and isotherms do not superimpose. Zero-field AC data are frequency dependent without a maximum; no optimum DC field is found. Debye analysis gives Ueff = 1.5 K and τ0 = 1.2×10−5 s, reported as SMM-like behavior.

properties.summary: Room-temperature χMT is 73.10 cm3 mol−1 K under 1000 Oe, slightly above the free-ion value, and decreases toward 2 K. Magnetization at 2 K and 5 T is 31.2 Nβ versus a 50 Nβ theoretical limit, with anisotropic non-overlapping isotherms and no clear hysteresis. Zero-field AC susceptibility is frequency dependent without a peak and shows no field effect; Debye fitting gives Ueff = 1.3 K and τ0 = 1.3×10−5 s, reported as SMM-like behavior. Crystal color is not treated as an optical measurement.
